title: Field returns with two housing adhesives
intro: A sensor maker ran a pilot of a new housing adhesive. Of 300 sensors built with the old adhesive, 21 came back from the field within six months with a leaking housing; of 300 built with the new adhesive, 12 did. With p₁ the old adhesive's return rate and p₂ the new one's, H₀: p₁ = p₂ against H₁: p₁ ≠ p₂ at α = 0.05. The test does not reject H₀, but the confidence interval for p₁ − p₂ says much more about what to do next.
